limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical facts about reversible rings, self-adjoint idempotents in star-reversible rings, and clean/semiperfect rings are prior art. The main residual risk is an equivalent elementary characterization appearing under different terminology or in a later/concurrent treatment of the new pro-star-reversible notion. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: Exact unit-group criterion for the projection-based pro-star-reversibility condition, with structural consequences for clean and semiperfect rings.
